name: @pryzm/typology-pack-residential-building
description: Residential building (multi-family) typology pack. A peer to casa-unifamiliar + apartment: a multi-storey stack of T1-T4 apartments around a central core (stair + lift) with an optional commercial ground floor. Ships the C50-compliant TypologyManifest + the min/max-m² + T1-T4 + levels brief + a GATED (default-OFF) bridge TypologyStageBundle. The building orchestrator (per-level plate partition + corridor spine) lands in later slices. See docs/03-execution/plans/RESIDENTIAL-BUILDING-MULTI-FAMILY-AUDIT-AND-PLAN.md + RESIDENTIAL-BUILDING-IMPLEMENTATION-TRACKER.md.
